## About the conference

The **Democracy and Political Violence Conference & Working Group** brings together
researchers studying political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes across
comparative and national contexts. The day features three main panels, a poster
session, and structured opportunities to connect researchers by shared interests.

- **Three main panels** with chairs and discussants — see [Panels](panels.qmd).
- **Full-day agenda** with breakfast, lunch, and a poster happy hour — see [Schedule](schedule.qmd).
- **Poster session** (~10–20 posters) — see [Posters](posters.qmd) to submit.

Organized by Sam, Gal, and Jack. See [About](about.qmd).
